- Reconciliation revamp is the Q3 anchor; the team will build rather than buy. Vendor options were costly ($140K–$180K/year), still required integration work, and one lacked needed tax-code support.
  - Scope: ~6 engineer-weeks, including FX-rounding migration.
  - Dependency: Karim from Platform is needed for ~2 weeks of ledger integration.

- Mobile receipt capture will ship v1 without bulk-select, which would add about a sprint.
  - User testing confirmed demand for bulk selection and a more prominent OCR-confidence indicator.
  - Bulk-select is planned as a fast-follow; the OCR indicator remains in scope.

- Vendor payout SLA target is 48 hours from invoice approval, improving current p95 from 71 hours.
  - Proposed approach: reduce ACH batching from 12 hours to 4 hours and add a second west-coast approver.
  - Engineering estimates the batching change at half a sprint plus SRE approval/monitoring overhead.
  - Proceed only if SRE considers the monitoring load manageable; otherwise consider intermediate targets.

- Audit-log retention update is deferred to Q4, confirmed with Legal.

- Internal admin-tool refresh remains with the intern team; no scope changes.

- Engineering bug-bash burnout needs attention; Marcus will propose a rotating on-call structure.

- Dan: update mobile receipt-capture specs by Wednesday.
